svg.title: PROSPECTIVE
svg.text: Share of mechanism-'forbidden' iid worlds whose oracle exposure effect tau_O is at least m_O = 2.5; noise strata kept separate.
n = 200 independent seeds per stratum, one forbidden world per seed;
k = worlds with tau_O >= 2.5. Strata share seeds and are not pooled.
sorted by tau_O; filled = at or above m_O
Reading: a forbidden mechanism label does not by itself imply an exposure effect; the plotted share is forbidden worlds at or above m_O.
eps=0 established; eps=0.1: platform-dependent, not established (D-048; post hoc).
